answer: Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a sable debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the canyon totals, and the yarrow anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 16 units per epoch, sustaining 125 aliases for 39 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
